items.title: Working Student Communications (f/m/d)
items.snippet: 01 · Why this role exists This year, RIZM has created unprecedented savings at our customers. We just aren't telling anyone. If you love telling stories, let's talk. RIZMO is our Agentic Energy Manager: an AI agent that helps industrial companies optimize their energy use and cut costs. We work with BMW, Stellantis, Boehringer Ingelheim and Bitburger. Right now, those success stories stay inside the project team. You'll change that. 02 · What you'll do You'll be our communications all-rounder and work directly with the founders and the go-to-market team. Storytelling: Turn customer projects, technology and energy-market developments into stories that a CFO or plant manager reads to the end. Video: Make short videos about customer projects and RIZMO, from concept and editing through to sign-off with the customer. PR: Pitch stories to business and trade media (Handelsblatt, manager magazin and others), write press releases and prepare interviews. LinkedIn: Plan and write content for our company page, and help the founders and GTM team with their own posts. We don't do Instagram, TikTok or blogs. Our audience is on LinkedIn and reads Handelsblatt. Events: Prepare our presence at trade fairs like E-world and Hannover Messe. That covers materials, booking meetings in advance and following up with the contacts we make. B2B marketing for long sales cycles: Our deals take months and involve many decision-makers. You'll build case studies and one-pagers that support a deal from first contact to signature. 03 · What you bring Student status: You're enrolled at a university. Your field doesn't matter (communications, journalism, business, industrial engineering, energy …) as long as you write well. Languages: Excellent German and good English. Curiosity: Energy, industry and AI interest you. We'll teach you the technical side. Ownership: You work independently, ask when something is unclear, and deliver. Nice to have: Experience with video editing, PR or event organization. Availability: 20 hours per week on-site in Münster or Munich, for at least 6 months, ideally longer. 04 · What we offer Pay: €16 per hour. Real ownership: From day one, you'll help build our communications from the ground up. Short paths: A direct line to the founders and fast decisions. Stories worth telling: Customers everyone knows. 05 · How to apply You love telling stories? Then tell us two. No cover letter needed: What topic could you explain for hours without ever getting bored? What experience from your studies shaped you more than any exam? items.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Vertragsmanagement & HR-Schriftverkehr
items.snippet: Die Mediengruppe Pressedruck ist ein Familienunternehmen und zählt zu den führenden Medienhäusern in Deutschland. Mit ihren regionalen Qualitätsmedien – der Augsburger Allgemeinen inklusive Allgäuer Zeitung, der Main-Post in Würzburg sowie dem SÜDKURIER in Konstanz – erreicht sie bei einer täglichen Druckauflage von rund 450.000 Exemplaren etwa 1,3 Millionen Leser. Unser Bereich Shared Services bündelt standortübergreifend zentrale Servicefunktionen innerhalb der Gruppe. Dazu gehören die Bereiche IT, Finance & Controlling, HR, Procurement & Sustainability (einschließlich Facility Management und Mobility) sowie Legal & Compliance. Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Termin einen engagierten und zuverlässigen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) für den Bereich Vertragsmanagement und HR-Schriftverkehr am Standort Würzburg Deine Aufgaben: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung, Bearbeitung und Verwaltung von Verträgen sowie weiteren Personaldokumenten. Du wirkst bei der Erstellung und Bearbeitung des gesamten HR-Schriftverkehrs mit und behältst dabei Fristen und Termine im Blick. Du unterstützt das HR-Team bei allgemeinen administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben. Du sorgst für eine sorgfältige und vertrauliche Bearbeitung personenbezogener Daten. Dein Profil: Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d), idealerweise in einem kaufmännischen, wirtschafts-, rechts- oder personalbezogenen Studiengang. Du verfügst über ein gutes kaufmännisches Verständnis und hast idealerweise bereits erste Erfahrungen im Personalwesen oder Vertragsmanagement gesammelt. Mit den gängigen Office-Programme gehst Du sicher und routiniert um. Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für digitale Prozesse mit und kannst dich schnell in neue Dokumentenmanagement- und Verwaltungssysteme einarbeiten. Du bist sorgfältig, zuverlässig und strukturiert und arbeitest gerne im Team. Du zeichnest dich durch Organisationsgeschick, Eigeninitiative und eine serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise aus. Diskretion sowie ein verantwortungsbewusster Umgang mit vertraulichen Informationen sind für dich selbstverständlich. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Wir bieten Dir: Eine abwechslungsreiche Werkstudententätigkeit mit vielfältigen Einblicken in das Vertragsmanagement und die Personalarbeit. Ein kollegiales und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld. Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen von bis zu 20 pro Woche , abgestimmt auf dein Studium. Du bist interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.title: Talent Acquisition Intern
items.snippet: Our Team We believe travel can create citizens of the world. We spark moments of connection and transformation, giving people the freedom to explore openly and shape their own story. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity fuels curiosity, insight, and a culture of openness, essential to understanding our travellers and one another. We work in a flexible hybrid model from our Utrecht HQ and our homes across the Netherlands. Just as travel is about discovery, we’re looking for people who want to go one stop further, joining a journey that inspires personal transformation through train travel. We’re looking for: You’re someone with a real interest in people and an energetic team player with drive and a genuine eagerness to learn, especially when it comes to finding and welcoming new talent. You’ll join our People & Culture team and work closely with Talent Acquisition on real recruitment projects, so you gain practical experience from day one. Our P&C team Our P&C team drives engagement and performance. We focus on all elements of People and Culture, including Learning and Development, Recruitment, Employee Relations, Office Management and Employee Experience. Within the team, Talent Acquisition looks after everything from the first job post to a new colleague’s first day, and that’s where you’ll spend most of your time. What you will be doing: Working closely with Talent Acquisition, you’ll gain hands-on experience in: Replying to candidates’ general questions by email, making sure everyone who gets in touch receives a kind, clear and timely answer. Scheduling interviews in close collaboration with our hiring managers, so the process runs smoothly for candidates and interviewers alike. Joining interviews alongside Talent Acquisition, so you can learn how great interviews work and build your own interviewing skills along the way. Creating employer branding banners and visuals that show what it’s really like to work at Interrail. Representing Interrail at recruitment events, such as job fairs and university career days, and helping to prepare and coordinate them. Research recruitment initiatives and AI tools used at other companies, and share ideas we could try ourselves while building your own skills in this area. Over time, taking ownership of hiring our future interns, from posting the role to welcoming them on board. Supporting the wider P&C team with general HR tasks, such as onboarding or answering questions in the HR inbox. Skills and mindset: (Working towards) a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, or a related field, or otherwise eligible for an internship (for example, with an orientation year visa). Previous (internship) experience in HR, recruitment or a related field is a plus, but not a must. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a warm and clear writing style, as you’ll often be a candidate’s first point of contact. Curiosity about AI and digital tools, and a willingness to experiment. Ability to work well in a dynamic environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Fluent in English. Our offer A monthly internship allowance of €650 (Bachelor’s) or €750 (Master’s). A travel allowance covering your commute to and from the office. 2 days of paid leave per month. We offer a flexible hybrid model that combines remote work with in-office days each week, promoting teamwork and connection. 5 working days from abroad per 6 months internship. A free global travel pass for you and a companion on completion of your internship, so you can explore Europe with your family or friends and share the same experiences as our customers. Joining monthly borrels and other social events. The opportunity to make a visible contribution, alongside gaining valuable experience for your future career. Curious to apply? Apply directly via our website Interrail Careers | Create An Impact . Preferred start date 18 January. We'll ask you to share your resume in English (our business language) and tell us why you're interested in Interrail and this particular role. It doesn't hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. As part of the process, we may also ask you to complete a short assessment to showcase your skills. If we think you might be a good candidate, the next step is a relatively informal interview with some of your potential new team members. For you, this is a chance to understand if Interrail is your ideal workplace, and for us, it tells us more about the value you would bring. In the meantime… If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a feel for our culture, values, and place worldwide? Got questions? Our People & Culture team would be happy to help - just drop us a note at While you're here, explore our travel passes and get inspired for your next journey at Interrail.com . items.snippet: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Are</strong></span></p> <p>Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.</p></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Program</strong></span></p> <p>We are currently seeking Software Engineering Interns to join Addepar in Edinburgh for Summer 2027.</p> <p>Being a part of the AddeU Internship Program, you will be working on meaningful project(s) that you can feel proud of and present back to the company at the end of the experience. Fun events and super cool swag are also included!</p> <p>Engineering is at the core of Addepar, and we are looking to add talented and motivated software engineers to our team. If you are passionate about doing the best work of your career and you enjoy the rush of shipping high quality code to production every day, we're excited to meet you! Our software engineers come from a variety of backgrounds. What they have in common is tremendous talent and dedication to architecting, implementing, and shipping high quality software.</p> <p>Edinburgh is home to critical engineering teams spanning data services, calculations, alternative data management, and data exchange - all central to Addepar's mission to serve Enterprise and Hyperscaler clients worldwide. As an intern, you will be embedded in one of these core teams, working on real projects that ship to production and serve Addepar's global client base.</p> <p>This role is based full-time in our Edinburgh office and requires in-person attendance for the duration of the internship. Dates are currently set for June - August 2027 but please advise your recruiter if you have any timing constraints. items.snippet: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer , you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing. What you'll be doing Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines. Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs. Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints. Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations. Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust. Your Profile MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus). Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship. Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal). Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis. Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation. Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team. Supervision and collaboration: The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen. Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren. De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid. Wat ga je doen? Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen. Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers. Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, capaciteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening. Je signaleert knelpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties. Doorontwikkelen van AI-agent Sparkle Je bent functioneel eigenaar van Sparkle en bepaalt mede de visie, roadmap en prioriteiten. Je vertaalt operationele uitdagingen naar praktische AI-toepassingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat Sparkle veilig, betrouwbaar en gebruiksvriendelijk functioneert. Je werkt samen met technische specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van deze digitale collega. Processen verbeteren en automatiseren Je analyseert bestaande operationele processen en identificeert mogelijkheden voor automatisering. Je optimaliseert workflows, kennisbanken en werkinstructies. Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen medewerkers en AI. Je draagt bij aan de ambitie om minimaal 75% van de standaard operationele processen met AI te ondersteunen of volledig te automatiseren. Verandering begeleiden Je werkt samen met Operations, Software Development, Business Consultancy en externe partners. Je begeleidt medewerkers in de overgang naar een meer AI-gedreven manier van werken. Je creëert draagvlak, communiceert helder en zorgt ervoor dat veranderingen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd. Wie zoeken wij? Wij zoeken een operationeel sterke manager die structuur weet aan te brengen, medewerkers kan motiveren en tegelijkertijd vooruitkijkt naar de mogelijkheden van nieuwe technologie. Je begrijpt hoe een IT-supportorganisatie werkt, weet hoe je processen beheersbaar en voorspelbaar maakt en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening. Daarnaast beschik je over: Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Managed Services, ICT Operations of IT Service Management. Ervaring met het aansturing, coachen en ontwikkelen van operationele teams. Goede kennis van ITIL-processen en servicemanagement. Affiniteit met AI, automatisering en digitale innovatie. Sterke analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden. Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete operationele verbeteringen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met verandermanagement. Je hoeft geen AI-developer te zijn. We zoeken juist iemand die begrijpt hoe je AI en automatisering succesvol inzet binnen een operationele IT-organisatie en medewerkers hierin weet mee te nemen. Wat kun je verwachten? Je komt rechtstreeks in dienst bij onze opdrachtgever en krijgt een sleutelrol binnen een organisatie die volop investeert in de toekomst van IT-dienstverlening. Je kunt rekenen op: Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.487 tot €6.494, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Een mobiliteitsbudget van €850 per maand, vrij in te zetten op de manier die bij jou past. Een fulltime dienstverband. Flexibele werkmogelijkheden en ruimte om hybride te werken. Veel zelfstandigheid en directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. De kans om actief bij te dragen aan innovatieve AI- en automatiseringsprojecten. Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen. Een betrokken team van collega's dat samenwerkt aan verbetering en innovatie. Waarom is dit een interessante functie? Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie. Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst.
